name: Захист (1)
description:
“The attack is the best defense”. Unfortunately, this wisdom does not always hold up in chess. If the opponent is aiming all their arrows at your king, you are forced into a defensive role. The art of good defense is to know how to parry all the opponent's threats. 

Sometimes it is a matter of “surviving,” after which you can win on the basis of positional or material advantages. 

What do you have to do? 

Parry the opponent's threats.

examples.text: The white battery threatens checkmate on h7. The best defense is 1...Rxc2! This costs an exchange, but black still has a material advantage after this trade.
Black has a double attack. Fortunately this is no problem, because with 1.Nc3! white still has everything under control.

texts: There was a threat of both a dangerous attack on f4 and ...Qg3+ followed by ...h4-h3. The danger has passed.
Black threatens an annoying check on g3 and the f-pawn is also hanging.
